## Station PCA Results

Each tab below shows an interactive 3D PCA biplot for a monitoring station. Points represent yearly means colored by k-means cluster (3 clusters). Loading arrows show how each water quality parameter contributes to the principal components.
Zoom in and out by scrolling up and down, respectively. Click and drag to change the angle of view.
